rewrites.//: Two discovery proposals disagree about this path. SEP-1649 puts a server card at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json, which needs `mcp` to be a DIRECTORY; SEP-1960 puts a manifest at /.well-known/mcp, which needs it to be a FILE. A filesystem cannot be both, so the manifest is stored beside it and served here. Neither is ratified — this is a bet on being found, not a spec claim.

headers.//: The discovery documents exist to be read by other people's agents, so they must be fetchable cross-origin. Nothing here is secret: it is the same information the page states in prose.
